details: Repositories are Spring components using MyBatis mappers and the application ObjectMapper; no adapter starts or commits a transaction.
Claim update SQL compares the expected version and increments the stored version; visible-member page and count share the member_id predicate and deterministic created_at/id ordering.
Audit statements only insert/read, with stable sequence/id ordering; database immutability triggers/grants remain required.
Outbox claim uses a PostgreSQL UPDATE CTE with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and a 30-second lease; retry errors are capped to the schema's 240-character field.
Receipt inserts preserve the JSON result and surface unique-key violations to the service; fingerprint comparison/replay policy remains service composition.
JSON values are passed through the configured Jackson ObjectMapper and JSONB text casts; application.yml enables BigDecimal float deserialization.
implementation.transaction_composition: The application use-case service must be a Spring-managed @Transactional boundary around claim mutation, claim/system audit inserts, receipt insertion, payment request and outbox enqueue. Use the same DataSourceTransactionManager/MyBatis SqlSessionFactory so these mapper calls join that transaction; do not call repositories through unmanaged sessions. Unique receipt conflicts must be caught/re-read only after rollback or via a deliberate savepoint strategy, then compare fingerprint and return the stored result.

verification.patch_scope_review: PASS: all 24 diff headers target only packet-approved mapper, persistence, SQL-resource or persistence-test paths; each proposed SQL statement was inspected for bound values and schema alignment.

limitations: Only ClaimPersistenceIT is supplied; dedicated AuditImmutabilityIT, IdempotencyIT and PaymentOutboxIT sources are missing, so this handoff is PARTIAL.

Payment creation/confirmation, independent concurrent SKIP LOCKED behavior, append-only role enforcement and unique-conflict replay races have not been covered by the supplied integration test source or executed.
No build, test, Docker or database command was run; XML dialect, Spring context wiring and Java compilation remain unverified.
Outbox lease duration is currently fixed at 30 seconds in the mapper SQL and requires coordinator review against dispatch timing/configuration.
